precepts.text: Write this down: women were never designed to lead men. As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err. Women ruling over you is a curse, brothers. Some of you are scared to lead your house and you have allowed her to lead. It is not a secret; everyone sees it. You must change the way you think.
precepts.point: Brothers, the same goes the other way: the moment you decide not to provide, not to be the man God told you to be, watch what happens to your household. It is a domino effect. Some of you brothers did not want a wife; you wanted a mama.

note.label: Agree Together | Bound Not Bondage

precepts.why:
Write this down: women were never designed to lead men. God made the woman “an help meet” for the man, and when that order is turned around, Isaiah 3:12 calls it what it is: “As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.”

That is a curse. It is not a good thing; it shows things out of order, not how God set it up. A woman's body alone shows she was not made to lead men into danger: her cycle comes, she is pregnant for nine months, and she is supposed to lead you somewhere?

Women ruling over you is a curse, brothers. Some of you are scared to lead your house and have let her lead. If you are passive, scared, afraid of confrontation, she is going to walk all over you. It is not a secret; everyone sees it, and other men see it in your demeanor. You have to change the way you think. Stand up and take your place back.

The women were designed to be a help to their husbands. When they step outside of that, and when the brothers allow it, chaos follows. That is why there is dysfunction in our nation right now: because the men do not want to lead.

note.label: Making the Great Red Dragon's 8th Head 'great Again'

precepts.why:
Isaiah says, “As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them.” These same kids become the neighborhood oppressors, running around with Glocks and taped-up mags and all that foolishness, and there is no man anywhere in the picture: no man with authority, no dignity, no order, no structure. Ecclesiasticus gives the charge that was missing: “Give him no liberty in his youth, and wink not at his follies.”

You have to hold those children in. You have to take that by the reins, because you are the one who is going to form their thoughts, their shape and their identity. Don’t give them liberty in their youth, and don’t wink at their follies.

Look at what happens when that is not done. They wanted to kill Julio Foolio over a rap battle: young, dumb, stupid people, wise to do evil. They used a girl’s phone to track him, bought AR-15 type weapons with brass catchers so the shells would not be left at the scene, and shot up his birthday party at a hotel. They thought they got away, but the police got every camera, the house cameras, the phone records, the tag readers and the Flock cameras, and the investigators took their time and put the pieces together. Lock, seal, smack, boom, you’re going down. Your ass is in jail and your mind is still a child. When the enticement wears off, reality seeps back in, and it usually comes with the arrest.

We have children in our nation too, some disrespectful to their parents, some who won’t listen. You don’t know what your parents are trying to save you from, and once you learn it, it may be too late to turn around. That behavior is not normal, not for our people, the royalty, and not period. And the eighth head knows this. They don’t care if it touches some of theirs; that is collateral damage. Their elite make sure their own children get the lessons they need to not fall into it. We are the only ones who eat this stuff up.

precepts.text: Children are their oppressors and women rule over them: only Israel has that problem, so my people is Israel.
precepts.point: Fear not, I will bring thy seed from the east and the west and say to the north, give up. Everyone called by my name I created for my glory; let the nations bring their witnesses, ye are my witnesses, and beside me there is no saviour. All the destruction is to set the twelve tribes back in their place.

note.label: The God Of War & Salvation

precepts.why:
Isaiah 43 says, “Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee.” Who is the “thee” the Lord loves and gives other nations for? Revelation 18 says “Come out of her, my people”, and Isaiah 3 identifies who his people are.

“As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them.” There is only one people with that problem: the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom, Israel. We are the only ones living under it.

So “my people” is Israel, not all nations. The fools who want to engraft all the nations say, what about all nations? But if you acknowledge that we are the twelve tribes of Israel and still want to engraft every other nation in, when are you going to acknowledge that they have to give us back our land and everything that belongs to us? You won't. It's hypocrisy.

The Lord has not dealt with any other nation. “Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory”, and “Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord.” All the destruction coming on the other nations is to set the twelve tribes of Israel, those keeping the commandments and striving, back in their rightful place.

precepts.text: Children are their oppressors, and women rule over them; that condition is a mark of a people gone astray, not the order of the Most High.
precepts.point: A sister helping to build up other sisters new in the congregation is right, and the sisters bless the nation with real talents, raising the children in the commandments, and the aged women teaching the young women. But teaching and leading the nation is not the place the Most High set for her.

note.label: Numbers 27: The Daughters of Zelophehad and the Ordination of Joshua

precepts.why:
Moses asked the Lord to “set a man over the congregation”, a man to go out and come in before them, that the congregation “be not as sheep which have no shepherd.” He asked for a man because the leadership of the nation belongs to men.

“As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.” Women ruling over the people is a mark of a people gone astray, not the order of the Most High; they which lead in that condition cause the people to err.

The woman was made to be an help meet unto the man, not to rule over him; she is the weaker vessel, and the congregation is not set up for her to lead it.

precepts.text: As the holy city is filled again, the haughtiness of the daughters of Zion is a warning against pride and outward vanity in the restored people.
precepts.point: This flows out of the covenant made in chapter 10, where the people entered into a curse and an oath to walk in the law of Moses, keep the Sabbath, and not marry the people of the land. Coming back into the land, they began to apply the things they had always done.

note.label: Nehemiah 11: Repopulating the Holy City

precepts.why:
As the holy city is filled again, Isaiah's word stands as a warning: “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will discover their secret parts.”

The haughtiness of the daughters of Zion, the stretched forth necks, wanton eyes and tinkling feet, brought judgment on Jerusalem before. For the restored people dwelling in the holy city, it is a warning against pride and outward vanity.

precepts.text: Where the order is out of course, children become the people's oppressors and women rule over them, the reversal of the house the Most High warns against.
precepts.point: This order, that every man should bear rule in his own house, is set up in the Bible for the man, and it is the very order the Most High established that the societies of the earth keep reversing.

note.label: Esther 1: Vashti Refuses the King and the Law of Order in the House

precepts.why:
The decree that “every man should bear rule in his own house” is the Most High's order for the house. Isaiah shows what it looks like when that order is out of course: “As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them.” The children become the people's oppressors and the women rule over them; the house is turned upside down.

“O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.” When the wrong ones are leading, the people are led into error and the way of their paths is destroyed. That is the reversal the Most High warns against, and it is the reversal the societies of the earth keep making of the order he established.

So the letters sent to every province, published in the language of every people, set the house the right way up: the man bears rule in his own house, as it is set up in the Bible for him.

precepts.text: The daughters of Zion are haughty with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, the proud look the Most High hates.
precepts.point: A heart that devises wicked imaginations such as sex changes, homosexuality and lesbianism; feet swift running to mischief such as gangs and gang initiation; a false witness that speaks lies; and he that sows discord among brethren through gossip and heresies.

note.label: Proverbs 6: The Surety, the Sluggard, and the Six Things the Most High Hates

precepts.why:
“These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him: A proud look”. He cannot be all love if he hates certain things, and the first thing on the list is a proud look.

Isaiah shows it on the daughters of Zion: “Moreover the Lord saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet”. Haughty, with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing: that is the proud look the Most High hates, and here it is on his own people's daughters.

precepts.text: A man is known by his look and countenance, so the sin declares itself.
precepts.point: The show of their countenance witnesses against them, and they declare their sin as Sodom and hide it not. You can know a sodomite when you see him, whatever he wants to call himself, because his whole countenance, the way he walks, acts, and talks, shows it; they are flamboyant.

note.label: Isaiah 3: The Nation Turned Upside Down

precepts.why:
“The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not.” Ecclesiasticus lays it out: “A man may be known by his look, and one that hath understanding by his countenance, when thou meetest him.” A man is known by his look and his countenance, so the sin declares itself.

You can know a sodomite when you see him, whatever he wants to call himself, because his whole countenance, the way he walks, acts and talks, shows it; they are flamboyant. They declare their sin as Sodom and hide it not. “Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.” There is always a payment for sin: “Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the Lord”.

precepts.text: The Most High would take away from Jerusalem and Judah the whole stay of bread and water, and the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, and the counselor.
precepts.point: Babylon made sure to put our mighty men to death, the same tactic the oppressor always used in slavery and segregation, killing the mightiest men to destroy the people's hope so they would no longer rise up against the enemy.

note.label: Jeremiah 52: The Fall of Jerusalem and the Puppet King Zedekiah

precepts.why:
“For, behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water, The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient, The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.”

That is the list Nebuzaradan took: Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, the three keepers of the door, the eunuch over the men of war, seven of the king's counselors, the principal scribe, and threescore men of the people found in the city. He brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and the king smote them and put them to death, “Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.”

Babylon made sure to put our mighty men to death. It is the same tactic the oppressor always used in slavery and segregation, killing the mightiest men to destroy the people's hope so they would no longer rise up against the enemy.

note.label: Spiritual Uprising: When God Shakes a Nation

Turn sisters into hoes and single mothers and say God will forgive you. That's not in the Bible.

It has molded her mind to come up with the conclusion that she doesn't believe this truth. We cannot use the excuse that we're too busy; you fail as a parent like that.

Just imagine if we lost all of them: the generation of us would stop. If everybody thought that way, we are the last generation; we're done. We would lose the whole nation. You do whatever the hell you have to do to make sure that this dragon don't get to them, because they're trying to destroy them.

It should be noted that we are a brilliant people, men, women; we're the greatest in the world, like I read in that book, Lost Tribes in the Promised Lands. We are gifted with natural intelligence and resources that makes our enemies seek to subdue our strongholds that safeguard our gifts, which is the Bible, the laws of God recorded in our Bible. Once they find and learn where our strength lies, like Delilah was sent by the Philistines to learn about Samson's, that's how they end up subduing him. Like Holofernes wanted to know; same kind of deal: you bind a strong man and you can go in and you can spoil his goods. I read that tale from that book called Puerto Rico: Flame of Resistance, and a tyrant said, I got to collect the truth and remove that from the people, then I can come up with new wars of conquest to destroy them. That was our northern kingdom brothers that came up with that beautiful tale.

Their objective is to control our minds; turn our minds around to benefit them and not ourselves. Once they start to shorten your attention span with them shorts, your whole thinking begins to change. And that's the gold rush of our enemies: avarice, to subdue and exploit us and our talents and our resources. Avarice means greed. They have an insatiable appetite for your talents, for our intelligence. They want us around, but they don't want us to do anything for ourselves. You have to know that about your enemy.

America is an engine. The engine is built a particular way and it runs off of a particular fuel. You can't put kerosene in it, you can't put water in it. You can change the name, but the actual fuel that goes in there to make that engine run has to stay the same. The con game: they're telling you the slavery is over. It ain't over; they just changed the name of the game. The fuel that it took to make this engine run is the same fuel it's going to take to keep it running. What fuel is that? Slavery.

Here's the fuel; they're getting ready to let you know the fuel still works. So if I shape this society to make you criminals, I still have slavery. If I miseducate your children, they cannot compete; they will resort to a life of crime. My jails are waiting for them. Who builds a hotel and don't expect guests? They built prisons all across this country waiting for your sons and daughters. The fuel is still the same.

Another example of the fuel, just happened last year under Trump: he was deporting all the Mexican farmers. So the whole agricultural association came to him and said, whoa, whoa, we want you to get these people out the country, but not these ones that farm the land. If you do this, we won't have any workers to work the farms. And Trump went on and said he going to ease back on that, and his whole base got mad at him, and it died down in the news. He not raided them places anymore, cuz they said, we need these guys. Who else is going to do this hard labor and farm work that they do for pennies? One of those major farmers said, if you remove this labor, within a week the American people will feel the effects, meaning the supply chain is going to be disrupted. So what happened? You don't hear about it no more. Keep them working. That's that fuel. They said, but as for an exception of a crime: so if they can induce your children into crime, they got slavery.
So that mean they're out to get your children. So when we go and be as hard as we need to be to keep them out of the clutches of what they're trying to do, that's love. That's perseverance.

note.label: Making the Great Red Dragon's 8th Head 'great Again'

points: As for my people, children are their oppressors: the places where we don't want to live is because there's wicked children in the streets with guns and violence, selling drugs and acting like thugs. The children don't respect nobody.

And women rule over them: women want to be in a position of power, full control. The court system is designed for them, the legal system is designed for them, the benefits are designed for them, and that's what makes them feel empowered: now I am a strong black woman.

O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err: God is supposed to lead us, but a system is leading us now. The system started with Adam and Eve in the garden. Satan took Eve out of her God-given divine nature and turned her against God, against her husband, and against the nation. So now, through God's teaching, we got to bring our women back.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty: haughty means mean, nasty. This is before America was established; God looked at the women and called out that spirit. And walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes: you're supposed to be shamefaced, but their eyes is in everybody's face. Anytime you see a woman that's not demure and is ready to stare you down, walk away from her. Train your daughters not to make eye contact with people, not to have wanton eyes.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: The Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments: whatever they put on that makes them feel empowered, the Lord said he was going to take it away when they go into captivity. The changeable suits of apparel: our women like to get dressed up, so God said, I'm going to take that away when you get taken as slaves.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Instead of a sweet smell there shall be stink, and instead of a girdle a rent: y'all would be disfigured and smell bad when the captivity happens. Instead of well set hair baldness: that's why y'all so obsessed with your hair now, and other nations have made it a multi-billion dollar industry. And burning instead of beauty: that's why there's so much cosmetic surgery now. The industry destroys our women and tells them surgery is the standard of what beauty is supposed to look like. God is showing you where you went wrong when you decided that you're the one who's strong.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war: on top of bringing the women down low, he said, I'm going to get your men also. The other nations enslaved us, changed us, and renamed us with the sword. So now the black woman looks at us as weak, inferior, a nobody. This is why we have to train them to look at us through God's eyes. You women are not strong by yourself: Eve was great in the garden because Adam was mighty.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: News played in class: xenophobic violence in South Africa; shopkeepers from Ethiopia, Somalia, and other parts of Africa closing their businesses in anticipation of looting, at least five killed, families from Zimbabwe, Malawi, and Mozambique in a makeshift refugee camp, a pregnant migrant woman chased from a Pretoria hospital and told to deliver her baby elsewhere, and migrants beaten in the street.

And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: that's what goes on in America amongst our people, and in Africa amongst our people. We hate each other and we oppress each other. What the South Africans are doing to migrants is the same thing you see some black people in America doing: get out of our country, you're taking our jobs. It's the same destroyed mind.

A land audit report read in class: white individuals own approximately 72 percent of individually owned farms and agricultural holdings in South Africa, while black Africans specifically own 4 percent of agricultural land. And they're mad at the people from Ghana and Zimbabwe. That's misdirected aggression: the people who stole your land and hold the resources, you're not going after them; you're going after people that look like you.

Video played in class on what colonialism does to a colonized people: it doesn't just steal their land; it robs them of self-confidence, until they internalize the colonizer's view that they're worth nothing and their history is minor. South Africa came out of apartheid barely a generation ago; to see them treat their fellow people like that is self-hatred, and it stems from colonialism. It's no different from black on black crime: brothers that will hurt a man for stepping on their shoes but never say a word to the oppressor.

News played in class: a South African court sentenced an outspoken opposition leader to five years in prison, on charges brought by AfriForum, an organization of Afrikaners, descendants of the Dutch, French, and German colonizers, that presents itself as a civil rights organization while existing to protect the economic inequality apartheid formalized. When the people of South Africa rise up angry about jobs and money, they're directing it at the wrong people.

points: "What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor?" saith the Lord of hosts.

note.label: Isaiah 3: The Nation Turned Upside Down

points: The daughters of Zion are haughty and walk with stretched-forth necks and wanton eyes, mincing as they go and making a tinkling with their feet. That is our sisters walking with straight-up attitude.

note.label: Isaiah 3: The Nation Turned Upside Down

points: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion and discover their secret parts. This is the plagues of the women; that is why a lot of our sisters' hair does not grow, because the Lord smote them with a scab on the top of the head.

points: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their ornaments: the tinkling ornaments about the feet, the cauls, the round tires like the moon that are the big head wraps, the chains, bracelets, mufflers, bonnets, leg ornaments, headbands, tablets, earrings, rings, nose jewels, changeable suits of apparel, mantles, wimples, crisping pins, glasses, fine linen, hoods, and veils.

points: Instead of sweet smell there shall be stink, instead of well-set hair baldness, and burning instead of beauty. That is why our sisters go through the perms, the straightening and ironing, the chemical burns, and the body odor and other issues, because of the sins of our people.

note.label: Isaiah 3: The Nation Turned Upside Down

points: Thy men shall fall by the sword and thy mighty men in the war, and her gates shall lament and mourn, and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
